danceable_songs <- taylor_album_songs |>
    #filter(album_name != "Midnights") |>
        group_by(album_name) |>
            summarize(album_danceability = mean(danceability, na.rm = TRUE))
            


ggplot(danceable_songs, aes(x = fct_rev(fct_relevel(album_name, "Taylor Swift", "Fearless (Taylor's Version)", "Speak Now", "Red (Taylor's Version)", "1989", "reputation" , "Lover" , "folklore" , "evermore", "Midnights")), y = album_danceability, fill = album_name)) +
    geom_col() +   
    coord_flip() + 
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Taylor Swift" = "#52d1ab", "Fearless (Taylor's Version)" = "#b39e2d", "Speak Now" = "#935dd9", "Red (Taylor's Version)" = "#7d282b", "1989" = "#73b4c9", "reputation" = "#1a241c" , "Lover" = "#e3a6dd", "folklore" = "#b6bfbf", "evermore" = "#4d3323", "Midnights" = "#1d276e")) + 
    labs(title = "Mean Danceability of Songs in Taylor Swift Albums", x = "Album", y = "Album Danceability") +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
